oneOrMany: One leaf: element-0, alternating world X delta +/-0.25 each Timer.periodic(250ms) callback.
changes: Geometry transforms only. Camera independently changes every animation tick over 0.223-4.482x. No text/style/content changes.
rendering: Each camera tick queries/culls/sorts viewport. A missing tile in Phase0.2 returns false: renderer records all visible elements. In-flight raster preparation can contend with foreground rendering.
measurement: stage=max(Flutter build,raster). CPU query/paint independent stopwatches. Tile image-await includes engine queue and raster wall time. No isolated GPU or physical frame presentation timing.
workIncluded: 16 warm+256 timed constructor-reference vs incremental microbenchmarks, 16 renderer cycles, and initial renderer preparation run before stress; not inside its measured window. Stress intentionally includes cold zoom buckets and post-invalidation raster work. Timer also runs warmup/drain; actual counts reported.
productionRelevance: Extreme combined navigation plus repeated committed leaf transforms, not a normal drag preview followed by one command. Command engine not present. New fixed-camera single/multi/offscreen workloads complement rather than replace it.
stallConcentrationBefore: Historical aggregates show periodic rebuild work (432 invalidations,561 builds; stress P50 3.2/P95 131.5ms), but lack per-frame timestamps, so exact commit/cold-transition correlation is unproven. New paired suite records timestamped frames/commits.
algorithmAudit: Matched scene deltas visit changed paint indices only; full sync scan is fallback for nonmatching base token. Chunk directory copy scales with chunks; no full text/path rebuild. Tile invalidation scans bounded resident keys, index updates changed entries. Spatial viewport queries still allocate sets/lists and sort candidates each paint.
candidate: Opt-in 256px mixed-region raster/live composition plus 16ms pacing between atomic image jobs. No fidelity reduction; default tile flag false. A hard raster-job frame budget is not guaranteed.
